title: Agent output WebSocket streaming
summary: Pre-implemented WebSocket streaming feature with 5 critical bugs fixed. All acceptance criteria met. Zero code review blocking findings. Security issues identified were pre-existing and unrelated to F035 changes.

key_learnings.learning: EventBroadcaster must always provide a destroy() method and track unsubscribe functions to prevent memory leaks. Without it, subscribers accumulate and are never garbage collected.

key_learnings.topic: Error Message Preservation in Async Context
key_learnings.learning: When catching errors in async functions, capture the error message IMMEDIATELY in the catch block before performing ANY async operations. Async operations (DB updates, logging) can fail and mask the original error.
key_learnings.code_snippet: catch (error) { const msg = error.message; await db.update(...); return msg; }

key_learnings.learning: Always check ws.bufferedAmount before sending data. If it exceeds a threshold (e.g., 1MB), implement exponential backoff or queueing to prevent connection drops and buffer overflow.
When an agent is stopped (AbortController signaled), emit an agent:complete event with final state. Without it, the frontend may hang indefinitely waiting for a response.
Wrap all ws.send(JSON.stringify(...)) calls in try/catch blocks. JSON.stringify can throw on circular references or unsupported types (BigInt).

process_insights.insight: Pre-implemented features with bugs are valuable learning opportunities
process_insights.observation: F035 was 100% complete but had 5 subtle bugs. The scout correctly identified pre-implementation status, allowing code-writer to focus on bug fixes rather than new implementation.
process_insights.lesson: Run scout phase even for 'completed' features—it catches these edge case bugs

process_insights.insight: Security findings must be separated from feature findings
process_insights.observation: Phase 4 security review found 10 issues, but 4 were pre-existing infrastructure vulnerabilities (IDOR, auth bypass, path traversal) not introduced by F035. Only 0 blocking findings from F035 changes.
process_insights.lesson: Track pre-existing vulns separately in backlog. Don't block features on infrastructure issues they didn't introduce.

process_insights.insight: Efficient feature completion with focused scope
process_insights.observation: Only 2 files changed (event-broadcaster.ts, agent-service.ts). 1 iteration. 0 retries. 35 minutes total.
process_insights.lesson: Single-iteration features indicate clear requirements and good planning. F035 is the gold standard for execution efficiency.

recommendations_for_future_features: Apply WS-001 (EVENT_BROADCASTER_CLEANUP) to any event-based streaming (F036, F037)
Apply WS-002 (ASYNC_ERROR_MESSAGE_CAPTURE) universally in catch blocks for server code
Apply WS-003 (WEBSOCKET_BACKPRESSURE_DETECTION) to high-volume streaming features
Apply AGT-003 (AGENT_LIFECYCLE_COMPLETION_EVENT) to all agent control features
Apply WS-004 (WEBSOCKET_SEND_SERIALIZATION_SAFETY) universally for WebSocket send operations
